name: Portfolio (Carbon-based)
source: Palette, type scale and sharp-corner stance after IBM Carbon (Apache 2.0). No IBM marks, logos or brand assets are used. Verify hex values against @carbon/colors when building.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground. About 40% of any layout.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Quiet panels and table header rows. Never stacked inside another panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings (16:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and captions (7:1+ on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines between rows. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Section rules, top rule of lists, table header rule.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Input and unselected-chip borders. 3.3:1 on white, 5.4:1 on #161616.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Fill: primary button (one per view), accent band, quote band. Text on it is on-accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on accent (5.0:1, so 14px+).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed fill for accent.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Links, overlines, metrics and wordmark on surface (5.0:1 on white, 4.55:1 on #F4F4F4, 7.7:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent-text-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Inline code and tag background, hover on unselected chips. Ink on it 12:1+.

tokens.name: danger-text
tokens.usage: Errors on surface. Never the only signal.

tokens.name: success-text
tokens.usage: Success on surface.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning and in-progress fill. Text on it is on-warning.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text on warning (10.8:1).

tokens.name: band
tokens.usage: Dark section bands (process, contact, footer). Text on it is on-band.

tokens.name: on-band
tokens.usage: Text and top rules on band.

tokens.name: on-band-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on band (8.9:1+).

tokens.name: band-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on band.

tokens.name: band-accent
tokens.usage: Wordmark Mint and link hover on band (7.7:1 on #161616, 6.4:1 on #262626).

tokens.name: field-bg
tokens.usage: Input fill on band, both themes.

tokens.name: field-ink
tokens.usage: Input text on field-bg, both themes. Never use ink here: it inverts in dark.

tokens.name: code-surface
tokens.usage: Code panels and terminals.

tokens.name: code-ink
tokens.usage: Default code text.

tokens.name: code-comment
tokens.usage: Comments and headers on code-surface (7.6:1+).

tokens.name: code-keyword
tokens.usage: Keywords, the $ prompt, live status.

tokens.name: code-string
tokens.usage: Strings, success arrows and values.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, 2px offset. On bands use #FFFFFF (focus-on-dark).

tokens.name: focus-on-dark
tokens.usage: Focus outline inside band and accent sections.

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Web apps and APIs, built to last.
styles.usage: Landing hero only, once per page. Fluid: clamp(2.5rem, 1rem + 3.2vw, 3.75rem) at 1.17.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Inner-page title, one per page. Not used on the landing page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings and metrics. Fluid: clamp(1.75rem, 1.2rem + 1.6vw, 2rem).

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: List and row titles, pull quotes. Fluid: clamp(1.5rem, 1.2rem + 0.9vw, 1.75rem).

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: We design, build and maintain web applications.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Body copy never goes below 16px. Max 65ch.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, nav, buttons. Table headers use 600.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Meta lines in accent-text. Sentence case, no uppercase.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon gaps, tag padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Label to field, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button groups, tag rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Field and table cell padding, small gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Row padding, panel padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Grid gutters.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Gaps between heading and content blocks.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Page side margin at desktop.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of a section band.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for everything: buttons, inputs, panels, bands.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Only tags and inline code.

tokens.name: radius-mark
tokens.usage: Only the monogram tile: one eighth of its size (16px at 128, 8px at 64, 5px at 40).

tokens.name: border-hairline
tokens.usage: Row dividers.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Inputs and tertiary buttons.

tokens.name: border-rule
tokens.usage: Section, step and table-header rules.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px offset.
